findings.description: The foreground subject is using his right hand to hold the razor, but the reflection shows the action being performed with the left hand.
The real subject holds a dark grey razor, while the reflection holds a white razor.
The real subject continues to hold the razor near his face, but the reflection independently lowers the razor, raises a black comb, and begins combing his hair.
